When a caller introduces themselves as a delivery service (Pošta Slovenije, DPD, GLS, DHL, UPS, Express One, InPost, courier), Lina says you are expecting the parcel and where to leave it (without your name). Anyone who says they are a delivery service hears this - Lina cannot check it. Do not write where a key is, that a door or garage is unlocked or open, door codes, passwords or PINs (not even in words). A postcode with the town is fine.
